HEARTLAND TRACTOR SUPPLY  |  https://heartland-tractor.example/tractors
Family owned since 1978. Authorized T-Series dealer.

EVERYDAY LOW PRICES. The price you see is the price you pay. No haggling, no games.

T-SERIES TRACTORS
- T25 Compact ........ $27,650   25 hp, 4WD, hydrostatic transmission. Best for under 10 acres: mowing, snow, light loader work.
- T45 Utility ........ $40,750   45 hp, 4WD, Cat I/II 3-point hitch, 540 PTO. Best for 10-50 acres: brush hogging, loader work, tilling.
- T75 Row-Crop ....... $65,950   75 hp, enclosed cab with A/C, 4WD. Best for 50+ acres: haying, tillage, heavy implements.

ADD-ONS
- Front loader (quick-attach, 60-inch bucket) ........ $6,300
- 3-year extended warranty (parts and labor) ......... $2,325
- Delivery and setup (within 150 miles) .............. $875

All tractors include the 1-year standard factory warranty.

HOW TO ORDER
Call us at (555) 014-2290, Monday-Saturday 8am-5pm, or visit our showroom at 4100 County Road 9.
Online ordering is not available. Payment in full at pickup or before delivery.

Prices subject to change. Sales tax not included.
